sections.heading: Multi-loop structure
sections.text: The PFC has three distinct loops: (1) inner current loop (fastest, tracks sinusoidal reference), (2) outer voltage loop (slowest, regulates bulk capacitor), (3) feedforward of rectified line voltage. Current reference = voltage-loop output * rectified line voltage shape.

sections.heading: Inrush limiting
sections.text: PFC inrush is severe because the bulk capacitor charges through the boost inductor with no current limit at startup. Use a pre-charge resistor (bypassed after startup) or ramp the current reference from zero. The current loop alone cannot prevent inrush.

sections.heading: Line-frequency sensing
sections.text: The rectified line voltage shape must be sensed accurately for the current reference. Use a dedicated voltage divider and filter. If the line voltage sensor has offset or distortion, the input current will have the same distortion.
